title: Meta moves Muse AI assistant into Instagram direct messages
teaser: Meta has added its Muse AI assistant to Instagram direct messages. Users in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore will be able to talk to it directly in a chat. Muse can provide more information about a post, place or product users come across in their feed, and help them catch up on messages they missed. Users can also share posts with the assistant and ask it, for example, to add a coffee shop to a Mexico City itinerary or find a discount on shoes for Black Friday.
